guidelinesCompliance.guideline: Never follow symlinks or remove project-owned, evidence, modified, unknown-owned, protected, unlisted, absolute, or escaping paths.

risk.detail: This Work Item adds confirmed filesystem removal. Risk is bounded by validated installation facts, exact digest confirmation, system-temp detachment, confinement, preservation, progress/final receipts, disposable tests, and mandatory human review.

observedIssues.fact: The installer lock was captured in the durable manifest and disappeared after installation, so copied clean adopters failed facts validation.
observedIssues.decision: Exclude the transient lock when creating facts rather than weakening uninstall drift checks.
observedIssues.resolution: The manifest omits .ai/cockpit/.install.lock and the clean-adopter lifecycle executes.
observedIssues.followUp: Retain the direct install-facts regression and Hosted installation-smoke.

observedIssues.fact: The global Work Item MODE value was reused as the uninstall mode and could turn the default preserve-evidence proposal into an invalid mode.
observedIssues.decision: Use a dedicated UNINSTALL_MODE variable in both root and installed Makefiles.
observedIssues.resolution: Clean adopter proposal generation uses preserve-evidence independently of Work Item mode.
observedIssues.followUp: Keep installed runtime parity and adopter lifecycle coverage.

observedIssues.fact: Root README language files could be classified as Template-owned and enter the removal set.
observedIssues.decision: Classify README.md, README.zh-CN.md, and README.ja.md as Project-owned in the canonical install manifest.
observedIssues.resolution: Facts preserve README content and clean-adopter execution proves it remains.
observedIssues.followUp: Retain direct manifest and removal preservation regressions.

observedIssues.fact: The first assessment logic could clear JA-UNINSTALL-RUNTIME-001 from source markers and public target names without proving clean-adopter removal.
observedIssues.decision: Require both the installed public surface and an executable clean-adopter lifecycle test.
observedIssues.resolution: The generated assessment cites executable facts/proposal/removal/receipt evidence and cannot clear from the legacy prepare model.
observedIssues.followUp: Hosted CI must execute the same clean-adopter test before merge.

observedIssues.fact: The first executor implementation ran from the repository script that belonged to its own deletion set, so the detached claim exceeded implementation.
observedIssues.decision: Copy the complete validation runtime to a system temporary directory and reject direct internal mutation calls.
observedIssues.resolution: Public CLI re-executes from temporary storage and receipts record detachedExecution true.
observedIssues.followUp: Review temporary-copy module completeness and cross-platform Hosted behavior.

observedIssues.fact: A symlinked receipt parent could redirect evidence outside the repository.
observedIssues.decision: Validate every receipt path component before the first deletion and atomically replace a non-symlink temporary receipt.
observedIssues.resolution: Symlinked receipt parents block with zero Runtime deletion; progress and final receipts stay repository-confined.

observedIssues.fact: The root Makefile was in Contract scope but restrictedWriteApproval remained false.
observedIssues.decision: Bind the user's existing continuous corrective authorization narrowly to the three uninstall targets and refresh Preflight/checkpoint evidence.
observedIssues.resolution: Diff ownership reports no approval_required paths.
observedIssues.followUp: Protected platform review remains required before merge.

observedIssues.fact: The first quality-fast run stopped because two implementation scripts required Ruff formatting and ai_uninstall_facts.py retained an unused os import.
observedIssues.decision: Remove the unused import, run the project formatter, and restart quality-fast from its full entrypoint.
observedIssues.resolution: The source is formatted without changing gate policy or skipping the failed run.
observedIssues.followUp: Require the restarted fast gate and full quality to pass.

observedIssues.fact: Full quality passed all 1451 project tests at 85.61% coverage but stopped because the detached executor added B404 and B603 LOW findings, moving the reviewed Bandit result from 111 to 113 while the baseline remained unchanged.
observedIssues.decision: Review the exact findings, reject any medium/high finding, add the baseline path to Contract ownership, and update only the count and canonical digest for the fixed executable and fixed argument list.
observedIssues.resolution: The two findings are LOW/HIGH-confidence and limited to importing subprocess and launching the copied executor with a fixed interpreter and fixed module path; the controlled baseline now binds count 113 and digest 0989691b9acd91420bbcebf154373cfad93b13698f74fc6d3c507955bcaafdb1.
observedIssues.followUp: Refresh Preflight/checkpoints and rerun full ai-finish; Hosted security evidence must reproduce the same baseline.
